findings.current: “I have no relationship with Great Hero Jeok at all. We’re just—pardon?”
findings.defect: The draft adds an interrupted second explanation that is absent from the spoken line, delaying the reaction to Jeok Cheongang’s declaration.
findings.rationale: The source moves directly from Taekyung’s denial to his startled response.
findings.replacement: “Great Hero Jeok and I have no relationship at all… Pardon?”

findings.current: “This old man has committed a grave discourtesy.
findings.defect: The translation gives Ak Bulgun Jeok Cheongang’s characteristic self-reference and obscures the explicit subject: 악 모 means Ak Bulgun is referring to himself by surname.
findings.rationale: Ak Bulgun, not Jeok Cheongang or an unspecified old man, is apologizing for his own discourtesy.

findings.current: “You should be prostrating yourself before me, and you dare raise your voice? You green-blooded brat!”
findings.defect: The draft loses that even a full prostration would be insufficient, renders the youth idiom unnaturally as “green-blooded,” and drops Jeok Cheongang’s trailing threat.
findings.rationale: 모자랄 판 preserves Jeok Cheongang’s overwhelming hierarchy, 대가리에 피도 안 마른 describes an inexperienced youth, and 확 그냥 trails off as a physical threat.
findings.replacement: “Even a full prostration wouldn’t be enough, and you dare raise your voice? You wet-behind-the-ears little bastard, I ought to…”
findings.source: “큰절부터 올려도 모자랄 판에 목소리를 높여? 이 대가리에 피도 안 마른 놈을 확 그냥.”

findings.current:
“W-Wait a moment! Please calm down! Calm down!”

“Calm down? You want to be fixed in a grave until your bones turn to dust?”
findings.defect: The first line corrects Taekyung’s panicked malapropism to “calm down,” so Jeok Cheongang’s literal repetition of “fixed” no longer follows from what Taekyung said and the exchange’s wordplay is lost.
findings.rationale: Taekyung mistakenly says 고정, “fix,” instead of the expected 진정, “calm down”; Jeok Cheongang seizes on that exact word to threaten to fix him permanently in a grave.
findings.replacement:
“W-Wait! F-Fix yourself! Fix yourself!”

“Fix myself? Do you want to be fixed in a grave until your bones turn to dust?”
findings.source:
“자, 잠시만요! 고정하세요! 고정!”

“고정? 백골이 진토 될 때까지 무덤에 고정당하고 싶으냐?”

findings.current: The old man standing before me, who looked like some tough old big brother at a nursing home, was actually a notorious thug in the Murim.
findings.defect: “Some tough old big brother” is awkward and weakens 큰형님’s sense of the highest-ranking or dominant man in the group.
findings.rationale: 큰형님 is a hierarchical gang-style comparison here, supporting the joke that Jeok Cheongang resembles the top dog among nursing-home residents while actually being a feared Murim delinquent.
findings.replacement: The old man before me looked like the big boss of a nursing home, but he was actually a notorious thug in the Murim.
findings.source: 양로원 큰형님 같은 눈앞의 노인네가 무림에서 악명 높은 일진이라는 사실을.

summary: One critical speaker-identity error, two major losses of hierarchy and wordplay, and two minor fidelity or wording issues.
